source_row.rationale: When an expired medication is identified during a crash cart check, the nurse should remove and replace it promptly per facility protocol, ensuring only current, effective medications are available for use during an actual emergency, since expired medications may have reduced potency or altered stability that could compromise their effectiveness when critically needed.
source_row.source_detail: Appropriate Response to Expired Emergency Medications
source_row.source_name: AHA — Crash Cart Medication Expiration and Replacement Standards
